//: THE DECLARED MODULE INVENTORY for Ecom (Synergy ERP) — names only, no routes and no proofs. This is what the sheet's Module column says exists; module-map.json is what has been CAPTURED and can be PROVEN, and it does not exist yet because nobody has run `pnpm inspect --app ecom`. The two files are deliberately separate: a module declared here with no entry there is refused BY NAME when a run reaches it, which is the visible version of 'nobody has walked this screen'.
//source: Read on 2026-11-07 from the Module column of the 'Test Cases' tab of two workbooks, which agree exactly: Synergy_ERP_Automation_Test_Cases.xlsx (Module is column B, beside a 'TC ID' column) and Synergy_ERP_Test_Cases_Sheet_Format.xlsx (Module is column A). 987 non-blank cells in each, 33 distinct values, same values in the same order. Neither workbook is in this repo and neither may be: they carry test data for a real system.
//method: Verified against an INDEPENDENT OOXML parser, not only this repo's reader (§AK). The independent parse walked the zip itself and placed every value by its own cell reference; the repo's readSheetGrid was then compared against it cell by cell — 15,808 cells, zero mismatches. That comparison is also what found the attribute-order bug that had made both workbooks unreadable. The Module COLUMN was located by its header text rather than by position, because the two workbooks put it in different columns.
//order: Sheet order, which is the QA's own grouping — master data, then products, then the procure-to-stock flow, then the cross-cutting ones. Not alphabetical: the order carries information a sort would throw away.
